targets.query:
from(bucket:"zaxenergy")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r._measurement == "data_gap")
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r._field == "status" or r._field == "duration_s" or r._field == "recovered_count")
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time","unit"], columnKey:["_field"], valueColumn:"_value")
  |> filter(fn:(r) => r.status != "recovered")
  |> sort(columns:["_time"], desc:true)
  |> keep(columns:["_time","unit","status","duration_s","recovered_count"])
